title: postapiauthregisterwithvalidpatientdetails
description: Verify that a new patient can register successfully using POST /api/auth/register with valid details and receive a 201 User created response.

title: postapiauthregisterwithexistingemail
description: Verify that registering with an email that already exists returns a 400 User already exists response, and that login with the same credentials still succeeds.

title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Verify that logging in with valid email and password via POST /api/auth/login returns a 200 response with a JWT token.

title: postapiauthloginwithinvalidcredentials
description: Verify that logging in with invalid credentials via POST /api/auth/login returns a 400 Invalid credentials response.

title: postapiappointmentswithvalidtokenanddetails
description: Verify that booking a new appointment via POST /api/appointments with a valid JWT token and appointment details returns a 201 Appointment details response.

title: getapiappointmentsuseruseridwithvalidtoken
description: Verify that fetching all appointments for a user via GET /api/appointments/user/:userId with a valid JWT token returns a 200 response with an array of appointments.

title: deleteapiappointmentsidwithvalidtoken
description: Verify that canceling an existing appointment via DELETE /api/appointments/:id with a valid JWT token returns a 200 Cancel confirmation response and updates the appointment list.

title: postapirecordswithvalidtokenandfileupload
description: Verify that uploading a valid medical document via POST /api/records with a valid JWT token returns a 201 Upload confirmation response.

title: getapirecordsuseridwithvalidtoken
description: Verify that fetching patient health records via GET /api/records/:userId with a valid JWT token returns a 200 response with an array of health records.

title: getapidoctorswithoutauthentication
description: Verify that fetching the list of verified doctors via GET /api/doctors without authentication returns a 200 response with an array of doctors.
